text:
morgan: Heads-up 1 7 9 q6b-int4 onboarding surfaced a duplication spike after tokenizer v2 merged. looks like fingerprinting mismatch during corpus merge. we need a safe dedupe + golden sanity. anyone free?

sasha: i'll take a look. early diffs show token boundary shifts (1-3 tokens) causing different hashes, not quantization noise.

lina: labelers reporting many near-duplicate resamples; backlog doubled. i've paused incoming slices to avoid wasted work.

jai: suggestion: re-fingerprint with tokenizer v2, cluster with minhash 0.85, manual review of top clusters, then conservative stitch. run a 2k canary first.

ashley: ok to triage relabel backlog. prefer false negatives on stitch to avoid collapsing intent changes.

morgan: plan: 1) re-fingerprint using token_window (size=64) with tokenizer v2 2) cluster minhash=0.85 3) manual review for cluster heads (first 50) 4) only update golden after relabel verification.

sasha: running dedupe canary:
python -m curation.dedupe --tokenizer v2 --fingerprint token_window,size=64 --minhash_thresh 0.85 --input s3://redwood-curation/incoming/q6b_onboard/2026-03-22/*.ndjson --output s3://redwood-curation/tmp/dedupe-canary-4682/
~12m ETA, will post summary.

ci-bot: canary q6b-int4-v1 deployed to staging (canary id: c-4682) :rocket:

lina: ingestion frozen and labeler-queue set read-only for 30m. tagging labelers: @ashley hold bulk assignments.

ashley: picking relabel backlog; prioritizing clusters that hit golden candidates.

jai: i'll run divergence harness comparing baseline q8b vs q6b-int4-v1 on canary set. will flag items where embedding distance >0.15 or token truncation seen.

morgan: include KV-cache prefix sanity check (we saw truncated completions earlier).

sasha: canary results: from 21,422 inputs -> 3,112 clusters (size>=2) at 0.85; 412 clusters include at least one golden. cluster CSV -> s3://redwood-curation/tmp/dedupe-canary-4682/cluster_summary.csv

morgan: uploaded first50 for manual triage -> s3://redwood-curation/tmp/dedupe-canary-4682/first50.csv

lina: auditing first50 now, marking ambiguous ones as "hold".

ashley: labeler note: many paraphrases alter intent; we'll mark most as non-duplicates. conservative stitch approved.

jai: divergence harness running. threshold: if >5% regression on golden subset we stop rollout and open a regression ticket.

morgan: action items:
- sasha: full dedupe sweep + cluster manifest (canary done)
- lina: triage first50 + hold ingestion (in progress)
- ashley: relabel backlog review for golden-touching clusters
- jai: run model divergence harness (in progress)
- morgan: file regression ticket if >5% golden regression

morgan: reconvene in 30m or sooner if a hard regression appears. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
